notes: Toy configuration for VS3 unequal-state fixture ASYM-1 (.kiro spec ascension-trials-scalable-two-player-analysis, Task 4).

One fungible normal domain; two Trials each worth first=2, second=0; optional allocation with residue; winner-take-all with shared-full ties; trial tiebreak total_power then shared; no final tiebreak declared, so Recognition-Point ties resolve as a shared final result.

Purpose: with a single fungible domain and two equal-value Trials, unequal budgets (A=2, B=1) give a genuinely rectangular 6x3 game whose every cell, per-side collapse and per-side canonical mixtures are hand-derivable from the rules. Budgets, matrix, collapse and mixture oracles live in the ASYM-1 fixture (REQ-9.4).
